scope: Authored Nepal technology and operating-requirement assessment. Not a legal classification, certification, customer survey or completed organization audit.

organization_types.title: Repair and technical services
organization_types.sector_question: Track diagnosis, customer-device custody, consent, parts, repair tests and return acceptance.

organization_types.title: Retail and distribution
organization_types.sector_question: Trace SKU/variant, purchase, sale, stock adjustments, returns, payment and supplier support.

organization_types.title: Manufacturing / small industry
organization_types.sector_question: Map production bottlenecks, equipment interfaces, safe isolation, maintenance and quality records; changes to machinery require competent engineering review.

organization_types.title: Software / IT services
organization_types.sector_question: Trace requirements, code/release ownership, test environments, service commitments and incident handling.

organization_types.title: School / training / university
organization_types.sector_question: Establish teaching workflow, accessibility, content rights, equipment readiness and student-data boundaries.

organization_types.title: Health service institution
organization_types.sector_question: Map critical workflows and sensitive data; keep clinical decisions and device approval with the responsible professionals.

organization_types.title: Financial service / cooperative
organization_types.sector_question: Map transaction integrity, approval separation, reconciliation and current regulator-specific requirements; this checklist does not establish compliance.

organization_types.title: Government / municipality
organization_types.sector_question: Retain official identity, source-linked requirements, procurement authority, public service continuity and records responsibilities.

organization_types.title: NGO / development organization
organization_types.sector_question: Map project evidence, funder reporting, participant-data minimization and field connectivity/support.

organization_types.title: Tourism / hospitality
organization_types.sector_question: Trace reservations, guest-data boundaries, payments, connectivity and service outages.

organization_types.title: Agriculture / resource enterprise
organization_types.sector_question: Check seasonality, field conditions, connectivity, sensors/equipment maintenance and usable local support.

organization_types.title: Research / student institution
organization_types.sector_question: Define research design, ethics authority, consent where applicable, provenance, reproducibility and dissemination boundaries.

modules.title: Business workflow
modules.requirement: Map the work from enquiry or input through delivery, payment and support.
modules.evidence_to_collect: Observe one complete work cycle and identify users, handoffs, exceptions and delays.
modules.deliverable: Workflow map, problem baseline and accountable owner.
modules.acceptance: The owner and actual operator can trace a normal case and an exception.

modules.title: Budget and lifecycle cost
modules.requirement: Establish an affordable acquisition, operating and replacement plan.
modules.evidence_to_collect: Obtain dated quotations and explicit assumptions for installation, subscriptions, support, power and renewal.
modules.deliverable: Comparable lifecycle cost scenarios and spending authority.
modules.acceptance: Every cost has a unit, period, basis and owner; unknown costs remain visible.

modules.title: Identity and access
modules.requirement: Give each person the access their work requires and remove it when roles change.
modules.evidence_to_collect: Inventory users, shared logins, sensitive actions and joiner/leaver procedures.
modules.acceptance: A test user can perform assigned work and cannot perform prohibited work; access removal is demonstrated.

modules.title: Backup and recovery
modules.requirement: Recover essential records and systems after loss or failure.
modules.evidence_to_collect: Identify essential data, tolerable loss, recovery time and available storage/connectivity.
modules.deliverable: Backup ownership, retention and restore plan.
modules.acceptance: Restore a representative backup in an isolated environment and compare it to the agreed recovery target.

modules.title: Power and connectivity
modules.requirement: Match equipment and service operation to actual site conditions.
modules.evidence_to_collect: Measure power/load conditions with competent staff; record link availability and required operating hours.
modules.deliverable: Site readiness and outage response plan.
modules.acceptance: Demonstrate agreed power/link failure behaviour safely before acceptance.

modules.title: Records and financial integration
modules.requirement: Keep transaction, stock and service records consistent with actual operations.
modules.evidence_to_collect: Inspect current record formats, reconciliation steps, access and software interfaces.
modules.deliverable: Record model, reconciliation checklist and integration requirements.
modules.acceptance: Reconcile a representative test transaction across affected records without unexplained differences.

modules.title: Training and adoption
modules.requirement: Make the solution usable by the people who operate it.
modules.evidence_to_collect: Observe language, accessibility, task familiarity, staff turnover and available learning time.
modules.acceptance: Representative users complete agreed tasks and an exception without the installer doing the work.

modules.title: Support and asset lifecycle
modules.requirement: Define who maintains, repairs, renews and replaces each component.
modules.evidence_to_collect: Check local service reach, included warranty terms, spare parts, subscriptions and response responsibilities.
modules.deliverable: Asset register, support handover and renewal calendar.
modules.acceptance: A realistic support request reaches the accountable person and the escalation route works.

modules.title: Procurement and supplier assurance
modules.requirement: Translate verified requirements into comparable offers and a reviewable purchase decision.
modules.evidence_to_collect: Read the applicable procurement documents, approvals, exact configuration evidence and amendment history.
modules.deliverable: Requirements-to-offer matrix, approval evidence and acceptance criteria.
modules.acceptance: Each material requirement maps to a source and offered configuration; unresolved deviations are recorded.

modules.title: Systems and data integration
modules.requirement: Keep connected systems consistent and recover safely from interface failures.
modules.evidence_to_collect: Inventory systems, data owners, formats, versions, volumes and failed-transfer behaviour.
modules.deliverable: Interface contracts, migration mapping and rollback plan.
modules.acceptance: Test reconciliation, duplicate prevention, rejected records and recovery using authorized test data.

modules.title: Security and privacy review
modules.requirement: Address concrete threats and sensitive-data exposure in the intended environment.
modules.evidence_to_collect: Identify data classes, access paths, third parties, likely failures and applicable current instruments.
modules.deliverable: Threat/exposure register, control ownership and incident process.
modules.acceptance: Test agreed controls and incident escalation; unresolved risks receive an accountable decision.

modules.title: Service continuity
modules.requirement: Keep critical services available or restore them within agreed limits.
modules.evidence_to_collect: Define service criticality, dependencies, outage consequences, recovery objectives and provider commitments.
modules.deliverable: Continuity runbook, dependency map and recovery exercise record.
modules.acceptance: Demonstrate recovery or failover against owner-approved objectives; record measured limits.

modules.title: Governance and accountability
modules.requirement: Identify decision rights and keep material changes reviewable.
modules.evidence_to_collect: Establish entity identity, accountable sponsor, operating owner, approvers and review requirements.
modules.acceptance: A representative purchase or system change follows the agreed authority and leaves a traceable record.

modules.title: Project and change delivery
modules.requirement: Deliver changes through agreed stages and measurable acceptance.
modules.evidence_to_collect: Establish sites, dependencies, stakeholder availability, migration windows and operating constraints.
modules.deliverable: Phased delivery, change, acceptance and rollback plan.
modules.acceptance: Each phase meets agreed exit criteria before dependent work proceeds.

modules.title: People and technical capacity
modules.requirement: Match ongoing work to available skills and accountable roles.
modules.evidence_to_collect: Map duties, workload, support coverage, capability gaps and lawful job-relevant assessment.
modules.acceptance: Named roles can perform the agreed operating and escalation tasks.

modules.title: Performance and research quality
modules.requirement: Measure whether the technology helps the agreed problem.
modules.evidence_to_collect: Establish baseline, numerator/denominator, period, sample selection and possible alternative explanations.
modules.acceptance: Reported results can be reproduced and are limited to the observed population and design.

context_questions: What problem and measurable operating outcome matter?
Which users, sites, branches and field locations are involved?
Which data is sensitive and who owns it?
What downtime and data loss can the owner tolerate?
What budget, staff capacity and support reach are actually available?
Which current legal, regulatory, procurement and contract instruments apply?
What existing systems, versions and migration constraints must be respected?
required_outputs: Evidence gaps and authorized next decisions
limits: Scale labels describe workflow complexity; they are not Nepal statutory enterprise-size definitions.
A selected profile creates an assessment plan, not proof that requirements are met.
Critical or sensitive operations need deeper review even in a one-person organization.
Technology/operating needs are covered; sector-specific professional conclusions require appropriate expertise.
